tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Look up one AliExpress product by its numeric ID: authoritative price, rating, sales volume, commission rate and category, plus what the cashback would come to at each CashbackPro level.

tools.name: calculate_cashback

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products · Private data: get_cashback_link · Public sink: calculate_cashback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products · Private data: get_cashback_link · Public sink: calculate_cashback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
